observation.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && echo "=== rootDSE namingContexts ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "" -s base "(objectClass=*)" namingContexts 2>&1; echo "=== base DN search ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "dc=example,dc=org" -s base "(objectClass=*)" dn 2>&1 | grep -E "^dn|^result"; echo "=== try admin bind ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapwhoami -x -H ldap://localhost -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w admin 2>&1'
